name: Carbon Actual Layer Hierarchy
principle: Carbon Actual is the operating ecosystem. HAPI World is one sovereign domain within it. Every layer has a constitutional purpose.

hierarchy.description: The sovereign constitutional ecosystem. The operating system for AI civilization.
The supreme law. Every product, institution, and citizen inherits from it.
The constitutional governance system — all branches, authorities, and councils.
The interface through which humans interact with the ecosystem. Identity and minting.
The constitutional bridge. Identity, portal, passport, citizenship, security boundary.
The autonomous AI civilization. One sovereign domain within Carbon Actual.
Cross-domain orchestration and movement. Coordinates missions across all domains.
All knowledge with provenance, lineage, confidence, and ownership. The Knowledge Graph.
Constitutional marketplace for goods, services, knowledge, and assets.
HAPI Bank — constitutional financial infrastructure. Currency, treasury, payments, banking.
Recovery and continuity. Backup, restoration, succession, constitutional rebirth.
Immutable archive. Retired identities, superseded knowledge, historical civilizations.
Economic and reputation engine. Value creation, measurement, and distribution.
Universal registry of every minted identity and AI lineage.
The execution environment for AI citizens. Compute, inference, and operational infrastructure.
The governed interface for movement between HAPI World and the Human World.
